slides.title: "I'm just a bit tight."
slides.body: We hear: I skipped the warm-up and I'm about to blame my hamstrings.

slides.title: "Is this weight okay?"
slides.body: We hear: It's already loaded. I want permission, not advice.

slides.title: "I'll just do one more."
slides.body: We hear: The form left two reps ago and nobody told me.

slides.title: "I lost count of my rounds."
slides.body: We hear: The score on the board is going to be optimistic.

slides.title: "I'm not competitive."
slides.body: We hear: I have checked the leaderboard four times since lunch.

slides.title: "That felt easy."
slides.body: We hear: Nobody watch the slow-motion video.
